description: This file defines the 'Author' entity class used in the book project. It models an author with a full name and a collection of books written by the author. It includes JPA annotations for ORM mapping, Lombok annotations for boilerplate code reduction, and JSON annotations for serialization control.

classes.name: Author
classes.description: Represents an author with a unique ID, full name, and a set of books they've authored. Implements equality based on full name and provides a string representation returning the full name.

methods.name: Author(String fullName)
methods.description: Constructor to create an Author instance with the specified full name.

methods.name: toString()
methods.description: Returns the full name of the author.

methods.name: equals(Object o)
methods.description: Checks equality based on the full name of the author.

methods.name: hashCode()
methods.description: Generates hash code based on the full name.
